answer_1.quote: We thus utilize the real datasets J1, T1, and T2 in CrowdWSA which involve the translated sentences of the target language by multiple crowd workers for the sentences of the source language as well as the golden translations.

answer_2.quote: We also use three evaluation metrics to verify the proposal. Two of them are GLEU and METEOR. We compute the average scores between estimated answers and true answers. The other one is the average cosine similarity between the encoder embeddings of the estimated answers and the true answers.
